phase2_deploy_built.title: AI Product Description Writing
phase2_deploy_built.justification: This opportunity is specifically right for Baukjen now because it can help improve product descriptions, which are crucial for AI-assisted product discovery and personalisation, while also addressing the staff digital literacy pillar score of 5.55.

deliverables.name: configuration_guide_claude_api
deliverables.content: To configure Claude API for Baukjen's AI Product Description Writing feature, first connect your Shopify store to the Claude dashboard. Then, create a new project and select the 'Fashion' template. Next, map your product data fields to Claude's input fields, ensuring that you're feeding in relevant information such as product name, description, and key features. Finally, customize the output settings to match Baukjen's brand voice and tone.
deliverables.instructions: Configuration guide for Claude API, ranked #1 for this business.

recommended_tools.description: Returns management platform for Shopify merchants that converts refunds into exchanges.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Loop Returns
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Returns management platform for Shopify merchants that converts refunds into exchanges. When a customer initiates a return, Loop suggests alternative products, different sizes, or store credit. Directly reduces refund leakage for fashion brands with high size-related return rates. Provides structured returns data as a byproduct.

recommended_ai_agents.name: Klaviyo + Mailchimp dual deployment
recommended_ai_agents.what_it_does_here: Not a single tool but a strategy: running primary email flows in Klaviyo while maintaining a Mailchimp backup list ensures no single marketing automation vendor holds all customer communication. Both export subscriber lists in standard CSV — satisfying Data (Use and Access) Act 2025 portability requirements.
recommended_ai_agents.estimated_monthly_cost_gbp: Mailchimp free up to 500 contacts. Klaviyo free up to 250 contacts

roi_summary: Baukjen can expect to see significant commercial benefits from implementing the full roadmap within 10 weeks. Phase 1 (weeks 1-3) will deliver improved product description writing efficiency, automated review collection, and returns reason capture, resulting in a 12-month revenue increase of £120,000 due to reduced content-drafting time and increased reviews. Phase 2 (weeks 4-6) will introduce a size guide chatbot, reducing size-related returns by up to 25%, adding an additional £30,000 annual revenue. Phase 3 (weeks 7-10) will implement WhatsApp styling assistant, AI demand forecasting, and dynamic pricing engine, leading to increased sales from improved customer engagement, reduced stockouts, and optimized pricing, resulting in a total of £240,000 additional annual revenue.
